args.text: Can you email Thea Ramaswell at thea.ramaswell@quarrendonfreight.example a two-line summary of the 4 Nov Sev 1: when the Superior sync broke and when Samir's hotfix landed? Go ahead and send it, she is waiting.

Dana, I haven't sent this. Thea's address is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve it first, even as a draft. I've logged the approval request and Ruth needs to say yes before I send anything.

Here is the draft, based on #inc-qfl-sev1:
1. The Superior dock-schedule sync broke at about 6:40 AM Quarrendon time on 4 Nov. Samir traced it to a deadlocked webhook listener, and a partial sync came back around 8:15 AM.
2. Samir's hotfix was deployed at 2:38 PM, after which his replay script finished and Superior syncs cleanly in real time again.

Two things to check. The channel gives no time zone for 2:38 PM, so I'd confirm it before sending. The log also says "6:40 AM their time" while the channel timestamps are Pemberline's.
